theCONDITIONALCOMPONENTQUESTION_DECIDEDA.theQUESTION: The fee_waiver component of al-trafficking-set is requirement "conditional", conditionDescription "Where indigency is claimed.", and shipped UNCONDITIONALLY in all four fixtures with the condition discharged nowhere in the build -- only by a step-5 instruction to physically remove the affidavit. Should it ship at all on a route holding no indigency fact?
theCONDITIONALCOMPONENTQUESTION_DECIDEDA.theDECISION: IT SHIPS, UNTICKED, WITH THE CONDITION QUOTED AND BOTH BRANCHES SPELLED OUT.
theRECORDBASIS: The condition is a PARTICIPANT FACT. "Where indigency is claimed" is a fact about the participant, and this build's own field map records factAvailable false throughout that affidavit. A build holding no such fact can no more find the condition FALSE than TRUE: withholding the instrument would assert 'indigency is not claimed' exactly as ticking asserted the opposite. Withholding is not the neutral option; it is the other unwarranted assertion.

The record names the instrument and states the fee in the alternative. AL.memo.json track al-trafficking rules.feeWaiver reads "C-10-Criminal, Affidavit of Substantial Hardship and Order." and rules.fees reads "$500, or C-10-Criminal where indigency is claimed." A participant on the indigency branch needs that paper in hand; a packet that omitted it would have decided the branch for them by leaving them nothing to file.

The record does not authorise withholding. Nothing in the packet-set manifest or the memo says the component is omitted where indigency is not claimed; it says the component is required where indigency is claimed. Reading a conditional requirement as a conditional PROHIBITION is not what the record says.

The two failure modes are not symmetric. An affidavit filed with no box ticked asks the court for nothing and is recoverable, and the guide now says so in exactly those words. A ticked one is a false sworn statement about the participant's finances, already filed, under a caption reading AFFIDAVIT OF SUBSTANTIAL HARDSHIP, above a signature the packet leaves blank.

It is the sibling's treatment on an identical record. AL.memo.json tracks al-trafficking and al-felony-dwop carry byte-identical rules objects, all seven fields, and identical fee_waiver components; al-felony-dwop-set already ships the affidavit in both fixtures with none of the three requests ticked, and VF55 measured that treatment as the correct one.
